title: Shared Vocabulary Schema
description: Controlled vocabularies and reusable structures shared by every Triodian domain. Domains reference these definitions with $ref (for example "common.schema.json#/definitions/riskLevel") instead of defining their own lists. All enumerated values are camelCase. This file defines no instance type of its own.

ratingLevel.description: General four-point rating, from least to most significant. The basis for priority, criticality, risk level, severity and importance.

priority.description: How urgently something should be addressed relative to other work.

criticality.description: How essential something is to business operation.

importance.description: Strategic importance of something to the organization.

riskLevel.description: Overall level of a risk, combining likelihood and impact.

severity.description: Seriousness of an issue, finding or non-financial impact.

simpleLevel.description: Simple three-point rating, for strength, threat, leverage, uncertainty and similar judgements where a critical level does not apply.

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence in an estimate, assumption or assessment.

alignmentLevel.description: Degree to which something aligns with a strategy, objective or standard.

likelihood.description: Five-point likelihood or probability of an event occurring.

impactMagnitude.description: Five-point magnitude of an adverse consequence if a risk or event occurs (risk-assessment convention).

changeMagnitude.description: Scale of change something brings about: from minimal adjustment, through transformation of how things work, to disruption of the existing model.

effectiveness.description: How well a control, mechanism or intervention achieves its purpose.

scale1to5.description: Numeric strength or score from 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).

frequency.description: How often something happens: measurement, reporting, review, monitoring, engagement or execution. continuous = always running; realTime = responds as events occur; eventDriven = triggered by a defined event; onDemand = when requested; adHoc = irregular, as needed.

timeHorizon.description: Planning or impact horizon. Default ranges unless a domain states otherwise: immediate = now to 3 months; shortTerm = up to 1 year; mediumTerm = 2 to 3 years; longTerm = 4 to 5 years; extended = beyond 5 years.

performanceTrend.description: Direction of a measure judged against its goal (better or worse).

quantityTrend.description: Neutral direction of change in an amount, without judging whether the change is good or bad.

workStatus.description: Progress of a piece of work such as an initiative, program, project, action, response or work order.

documentStatus.description: Approval state of a document, artefact, policy or standard.

implementationStatus.description: Implementation state of a control, technology, strategy or practice. implemented = in place; operational = in routine use; verified = independently confirmed effective.

complianceStatus.description: Compliance state against a regulation, standard or policy.

lifecycleStage.description: Delivery lifecycle stage of something the organization builds or runs, such as a capability component, service, product feature or initiative output.

adoptionStage.description: Position in a market or technology adoption curve, for an industry, technology, product category or trend.

maturityLevel.description: Five-level capability maturity model: initial = ad hoc; repeatable = disciplined but not standard; defined = standard and documented; managed = measured and controlled; optimizing = continuously improved.

automationLevel.description: Degree of automation in a process, service, measure or activity.

riskCategory.description: Category of risk. compliance covers regulatory risk; technology covers technical failure and obsolescence; security covers cybersecurity; people covers workforce, skills, capacity and labour; environmental covers natural-environment and climate risk; external covers other outside events beyond the organization's control.

domainType.description: A Triodian metamodel domain, used when one record refers to an entity in another domain.

dependencyStrength.description: How strongly one entity depends on another: critical = cannot function without it; important = significantly degraded without it; supportive = helped by it; optional = minor benefit.

geographicScope.description: Geographic reach. regional = within a state, province or sub-national region; multinational = several specific countries; virtual = no physical geographic limit.

identifier.description: Unique identifier of a record within its domain, for example "CAP-001" or "MKT-ENTSW-001".

moneyAmount.description: A monetary amount in a stated currency.

entityReference.description: A reference to an entity in any domain, by identifier.

title.description: Name of the referenced entity, for readability

dependency.description: An entity in another domain that this record depends on.

performanceIndicator.description: A metric used to measure performance, with current and target values.
